VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: Naturastodis
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Naturastodis is a path only available to pawns with the natural meditation focus type. They are capable of harnessing the power of nature to hinder their enemies or to enhance your pawns or animals.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Naturastodis psycasters are mostly Foxians, or non-Foxians living among them. They are capable of exploiting nature itself for their own goals. They are generally seen as support psycasters, as they can help their allies by healing them, strengthening tamed animals, or granting them blessings from sacrificial rituals. Additionally, they can also weaken their enemies with various offensive psycasts, such as launching wood lances or placing artificial wooden mines.
